ios.desc:
▶ Full Featured Run Tracker
- Automatic start and stop detection
- Monitor your pace, distance, and time
- Seamless sync with Apple Health
- Share your achievements right to Instagram
- Use the Live Activity for real-time updates

▶ Simple Progress Tracking
- Weekly, monthly, and yearly stats
- Visualize your consistency with the weekly grid

▶ Distance Goals
- Personalize your running targets: weekly, monthly, yearly
- Convenient in-app and widget tracking for simple goal management

▶ Simple but better graphs
- Insights from your historical progress
- Effortlessly align your efforts with your goals

▶ Home Screen Widgets 
- Monitor your progress with the activity grid
- Display weekly, monthly, and yearly distances
- Track all your distance goals on the home screen

▶ On-the-Run with Friends 
- Share your latest runs and achievements with friends
- Motivate each other with emoji reactions

▶ Notifications 
- Receive comprehensive weekly summaries
- Explore detailed monthly statistics
- Celebrate your year in review
- Get timely goal reminders to stay on track

---
